This page lists every requirement of **[NL-CS Part 3](/edi-stelsel/documents/nl-cs-part-3)** (NL-CS Evaluation Instruction for Evaluation Laboratories, version RC1.0) as published on 6 November 2026. The [PDF](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf) is authoritative: each requirement links to the page it is on. You can also read the [full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-part-3) or [search all requirements](/edi-stelsel/requirements).

**15 entries:** 15 evidence items. **Obligation:** 15 mandatory.

**Legal basis of the document:** [CIR 2024/2981](/edi-stelsel/legal-basis#eu-2024-2981).

## 3 Evidence checklist

[Read section 3 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-part-3#s-3)

### E1 — FIT ST (Wallet Security Specification) {#e1}

Final version, claiming conformance to the Protection Profile; instantiates its operations; mirrors the environmental requirements table; identifies the functional certificate; states the TOE boundary and the architecture variant.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E2 — Functional certificate and report {#e2}

The functional certificate or attestation for the same product and exact version, with the functional conformity assessment report where available.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E3 — Specification of the functionality {#e3}

At the level of the interfaces and their parameters, including the interfaces with the WSCA-BE, the WSCD and the Wallet Provider backend.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E4 — Development process documentation {#e4}

Including vulnerability and patch management.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E5 — Design documentation {#e5}

At the level of the modules of the module decomposition of the Protection Profile: wallet core; WSCA/WSCD interface; optional remote signing module; presentation and proximity interface; modules specific to the architecture variant.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E6 — Security architecture description {#e6}

Self-protection, secure communication channels, key management, attestation handling (Wallet Instance Attestation, Key Attestation), resilience mechanisms (obfuscation, anti-deobfuscation, integrity, debug and platform state detection, screen protection).

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E7 — Source code {#e7}

Complete source code of the Wallet Instance, with its build instructions. Failure to provide it counts as an evaluation failure.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E8 — Setup and User Guide (SUG) {#e8}

How to install, configure and use the Wallet Instance securely, in the language fixed in the evaluation plan.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E9 — Test samples and access {#e9}

Installable builds identical to the production release, target devices or access to them, and test accounts or a working backend, including the WSCA-BE and WSCD access needed to operate the TOE.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E10 — Product identification data {#e10}

Application identifier, version name, version code, build or release identifier, signing certificate fingerprint, and a cryptographic digest of the delivered package.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E11 — Third-party components {#e11}

Libraries and SDKs with versions, as used in the build.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 7](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=7)



### E12 — Update mechanism description {#e12}

How updates are produced, signed, distributed and verified, per software component.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 8](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=8)



### E13 — Risk assessment {#e13}

The product developer's risk assessment for the specific architecture.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 8](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=8)



### E14 — Assurance information for components outside the TOE {#e14}

WSCD certificate and report; WSCA-BE assurance information where outside the TOE.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 8](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=8)



### E15 — Test to requirement mapping inputs {#e15}

The product developer's own test evidence, if any, for the Protection Profile requirements.

**Evidence item** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 8](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-part3-RC1.0_-_for_publ.pdf#page=8)
